fullTextZH: 今天我要给你说一个旅游的故事
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you a travel story.

fullTextZH: Didi是一个很漂亮的女孩子
fullTextEN: Didi is a very beautiful girl.
Didi looks very cute when she smiles.

fullTextZH: 她和我学中文差不多一年了
fullTextEN: She has been learning Chinese with me for almost a year.
While Didi was traveling in China,

fullTextZH: 这个男人看起来怎么样

fullTextEN: This man is not very tall.

fullTextZH: 你要和我一起去喝茶吗
fullTextEN: Do you want to go have tea with me?

fullTextZH: 虽然我不认识这个男人
fullTextEN: Although I don't know this man

fullTextZH: 可是我想和他练习中文
fullTextEN: But I want to practice Chinese with him.
And she wants to try having tea.
They are going to the teahouse.

fullTextZH: 这个男人的英文不太好
fullTextEN: This man's English is not very good.
So she chats with Didi in Chinese.
They can talk about the weather.

fullTextZH: 可以聊他们的工作还有生活
fullTextEN: They can talk about their work and life.

fullTextZH: 这个男人和Didi说我想和你结婚
fullTextEN: This man said to Didi, 'I want to marry you.'
At that time, Didi was still learning Chinese.

fullTextZH: 所以她有点不相信自己的耳朵
fullTextEN: So she couldn't believe her ears.

fullTextZH: 然后这个男人又说了一遍
fullTextEN: Then the man said it again.
Because I think you are very beautiful

fullTextZH: 你所有的地方都很漂亮
fullTextEN: Every part of you is very beautiful
No, no, no, of course not

fullTextZH: 你不能和不认识的人结婚啊
fullTextEN: You can't marry someone you don't know
Do you know what my name is
Then you can be my girlfriend.
I need to call my mom.
Then she returned to the Netherlands.

fullTextZH: 可是这个故事还没有完
fullTextEN: But this story is not over yet.

fullTextZH: 这个男人还在给Didi发消息
fullTextEN: This man is still sending messages to Didi.
He said he wants to go to the Netherlands to find Didi.

fullTextZH: Didi觉得这个男人真的很奇怪
fullTextEN: Didi thinks this man is really strange.

fullTextZH: 所以她不回这个男人的消息
fullTextEN: So she doesn't reply to this man's messages.

fullTextZH: 你觉得这个男人想做什么
fullTextEN: What do you think this man wants to do?
Why does he want to marry Didi?
